source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list properties (PDF 92-93).

items: Dynamic size: cheezein jorne ya hatane par list barh ya ghat sakti hai.
Index se pohanch: pehli cheez ka index 0, doosri ka 1, waghaira.
Tarteeb wala majmooa: cheezein usi tarteeb mein rehti hain jis mein jori gayin.
Mukhtalif qismein: ek list mein adad, alfaaz aur doosri lists bhi ho sakti hain.
Mutability: banne ke baad cheezein badli, jori ya hatayi ja sakti hain.
Duplicates: ek hi qeemat ek se zyada baar aa sakti hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks", "Cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloons"]
items.append("Party Hats")
items.remove("Snacks")
print("After modifications:", items)
print("Heterogeneous list:", ["Apple", 42, 3.14, True])
print("Number of items:", len(items))    # 5
print("Item at index 2:", items[2])      # Plates

Tabdeeliyon ke baad list Decorations, Cold drinks, Plates, Balloons, Party Hats hai: tarteeb qaim rahi aur list zaroorat ke mutabiq barhi aur ghati. Lists nested ho sakti hain, list ke andar list, jo pecheeda data ke liye mufeed hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Lists ki dynamic size ki khasusiyat aur yeh unhein kaise lachakdar banati hai, bataiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Python list ka size pehle se muqarrar nahi karna parta: append(), insert() aur extend() ise barhate aur remove(), pop() aur clear() ghatate hain, aur Python memory khud adjust karti hai. Is liye program aisa data rakh sakta hai jis ki miqdar maloom na ho, jaise user input, shopping cart ki cheezein ya kaam, baghair jagah zaya kiye ya kam pare.

items: List ki khasusiyat: dynamic size, 0 se index, tarteeb wali, mukhtalif qismein, badalne qabil, duplicates ki ijazat.
